xfail: the keyway across the inner rim fillet boxes part of the trim above its original end plane
note: Integrate the annular slices with the rectangle outside the bore removed. The fillet changes the two radii by 0.8 times (1 - cos(theta)); use the exposed bore arc and planar keyway walls for area. No cut or fillet can add material above Y = 0 and the upper end face survives.
